text: Accepted Account Hub select styling uses critical semantic tokens for warnings and keeps a dedicated focus-visible outline. Warning text wraps and spacing uses logical properties. Recommend following this component's tokens and logical geometry when changing its warning styles. This is a current source pattern, not verified contrast, forced-color rendering or a global style rule. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.
title: Keep current warning CSS tied to semantic color and focus roles
